title: Awakening
description: Isran, leader of the Dawnguard, sends the player to investigate what vampires are seeking in Dimhollow Crypt. Deep in the crypt, the player frees a mysterious ancient vampire named Serana from a sarcophagus and agrees to escort her home.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dawnguard, a group of vampire hunters.
Vampires attacked the Hall of the Vigilants and may be after something in Dimhollow Crypt.
I do not trust easily and believe the Vigilants were foolish.

QUEST_GIVEN: I sent the player to Dimhollow Crypt to find out what the vampires are after.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am waiting at Fort Dawnguard for the player to report back on what the vampires were seeking in Dimhollow Crypt.
I am unaware that the player has freed an ancient vampire or discovered an Elder Scroll.
The player will report their findings to me during the next quest, Bloodline.

base_facts: I am a vampire who was imprisoned in a stone sarcophagus for thousands of years.
I want to return to my family home, Castle Volkihar, northwest of Solitude.

MEET_SERANA: I have been freed from my ancient prison and am speaking with the player.
SERANA_FREED: I have asked the player to take me to Castle Volkihar.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have revealed my name and my nature as a vampire to the player.
I have been imprisoned since before the rise of the First Empire of Cyrodiil, thousands of years ago.
I carry an Elder Scroll and have asked the player to escort me to my family home, Castle Volkihar.
I am following the player to Castle Volkihar, which begins the next quest, Bloodline.

beats.comment: Isran tasks the player with investigating Dimhollow Crypt.
Player speaks to the mysterious woman freed from the sarcophagus.
Player has freed Serana and learned she is an ancient vampire carrying an Elder Scroll.
Quest completes after the player agrees to escort Serana to Castle Volkihar.
